title.narrative: Nuclear Safety Cooperation with Georgia 2020 - 2022 - G.4.01/19A

description.narrative: Improving the safety of radioactive waste management in the country and supporting the implementation of the national radioactive waste management strategy. The strategy considers allocation of all radioactive waste management facilities on one site to develop integrated system for radioactive waste management. It is also considered that existing storage facility cannot meet all safety requirements and its reconstruction for this purpose is impossible.
